items.title: ‎’Man Utd have a lot to learn’ – Carrick speaks on Hull defeat
items.description: Michael Carrick admitted Manchester United have “a lot to learn” after suffering a surprise 2-0 defeat at Hull in their opening game of the Premier League season on Saturday. Carrick’s side were ripped to shreds by the rampant Tigers as first-half goals from Semi Ajayi and Nobel Mendy caused a shock at the MKM Stadium. United were toothless in attack and inept at the back, a fatal combination that allowed promoted Hull to celebrate their return to the Premier League after a nine-year absence. Hoping to challenge for the title after finishing third last season, United looked well short of the standard set by champions Arsenal. Carrick conceded United have much to work on after being punished for sloppy defending at two set-pieces. “We have a bit to improve on, it was never going to be perfect. Going behind makes it more difficult, against a promoted team at home,” he said. “We can’t give them much and they had opportunities. We’re disappointed but it won’t knock us.” Carrick had warned against underestimating Hull and next week’s opponents Ipswich, the second promoted side United will face this season. His caution proved well founded, but Carrick vowed United would be better for the painful defeat. “It’s for us to know and to improve during the week and keep getting stronger as a group. We have a lot to learn from it,” he said. “Two goals is frustrating anyway. They decide the game today and there’s things to improve on.” Carrick had asked for United’s hierarchy to make more signings after a relatively quiet transfer window. Debutants Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos were both anonymous in midfield before being hauled off by Carrick in the second half. United have agreed a deal to sign Brighton midfielder Carlos Baleba, but more new recruits will be required on the evidence of this lacklustre display. “One game doesn’t change the direction of everything. It doesn’t change the direction of the football club,” Carrick said. Asked about Baleba’s impending move, Carrick added: “I had all eyes on this today so any other player, until he’s ours, it’s not for me to comment on.” United captain Bruno Fernandes, who set the Premier League’s single-season assist record last season, struggled to impose himself and wore a furious expression well before the final whistle. Fernandes wasn’t alone in showing his frustration as United’s angry fans made their feelings known. “We understand the frustration, every season at the start we want to compete and win every game but we need the fans on our side, and to believe in ourselves,” Fernandes said. “We know in the Premier League these types of away grounds are difficult to play against. You need to match their intensity and aggression. The two set pieces ended up costing us the game today.” AFP The post ‎’Man Utd have a lot to learn’ – Carrick speaks on Hull defeat appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Husband, servant detained after woman found dead with hands bound in Rawalpindi apartment
items.description: RAWALPINDI: Police have detained the husband and domestic servant of a 45-year-old woman who was found dead with her hands tied behind her back at an apartment in Rawalpindi, while her elderly father-in-law is also being questioned as part of the investigation. The woman, identified as Hina Javaid, was found dead in the washroom of her apartment in Askari Apartments, Lal Kurti, on Thursday evening. Police said the body bore signs of torture, with a wire fastened around her neck and tied to the shower rod. According to the first information report (FIR), registered on Aug 20 at the Civil Lines police station under Sections 302 (premeditated murder) and 34 (common intention) of the Pakistan Penal Code, Hina’s brother, Fahid Javaid, alleged that his sister had been murdered by her husband, his father and their domestic servant. Fahid told police that he received a telephone call from his sister’s father-in-law at around 6:53pm on Thursday, informing him of an emergency at the residence. He said he rushed to the apartment with other family members and arrived there at about 7:23pm. He claimed that when he arrived at the residence, he found his sister’s body in the bathroom. The complainant further alleged that his sister had been subjected to “severe torture and mistreatment” by her husband. He also claimed that she might have been administered a poisonous substance before her death. The police report, prepared after officers reached the apartment, also recorded that Hina’s hands were tied behind her back and an electrical wire was fastened around her neck and tied to the shower rod. An initial postmortem examination indicated a strangulation mark around her neck, an injury below her right lip and bleeding, according to the police report. A team from the Punjab Forensic Science Agency (PFSA) also visited the apartment and collected evidence from the scene. The body was subsequently shifted to the District Headquarters Hospital for a postmortem examination. A police spokesman said Hina’s husband and their domestic servant had been detained on murder charges. The father-in-law, a 78-year-old man, is being questioned by police. Police have also recorded statements from the suspects as the investigation continues under the supervision of a team of senior officers. In his complaint, Fahid said Hina had married the suspect in November 2025. The allegations contained in the FIR are subject to investigation, while police are examining forensic evidence and other circumstances surrounding Hina’s death.

La guerre contre l'Iran éclipse la puissance pétrolière des États-Unis
items.description: La perturbation des approvisionnements energetiques en provenance du Moyen-Orient, provoquee par la guerre entre les etats-Unis et l'Iran, a largement eclipse la progression de la production petroliere americaine, selon des experts cites par le Financial Times le 21 août . Washington aurait ainsi dilapide une partie de l'avantage energetique dont il disposait. Les etats-Unis restent le premier producteur mondial de petrole, mais la hausse attendue de leur production demeure tres limitee. Selon les estimations de l'Administration americaine d'information sur l'energie, elle ne devrait augmenter que de 200 000 barils par jour cette annee. Ce volume est derisoire au regard des perturbations provoquees par la guerre contre l'Iran. Environ 20 millions de barils par jour, qui transitaient auparavant par le detroit d'Ormuz depuis le Moyen-Orient, sont desormais bloques. Autrement dit, l'augmentation de la production americaine ne suffit absolument pas a compenser les volumes retires du marche par la fermeture de cette voie maritime strategique. Pour Art Berman, consultant en energie base a Houston, cette situation revele surtout une profonde incomprehension des enjeux energetiques au sein de l'administration de Donald Trump. Il juge que les responsables americains sous-estiment les mecanismes du marche et les consequences que leurs decisions peuvent avoir sur l'approvisionnement energetique. La guerre contre l'Iran se repercute sur le quotidien des Americains Les repercussions du conflit ne se limitent d'ailleurs pas au petrole. Depuis le debut des hostilites, les prix de l'essence et du diesel aux etats-Unis ont bondi d'environ 40 %. Le prix moyen du diesel sous Donald Trump a meme depasse le niveau observe pendant la presidence de Joe Biden. Dans le meme temps, les tensions inflationnistes se sont accentuees. En mai, l'inflation americaine a atteint 4,2 %, son plus haut niveau depuis trois ans. Les conditions d'emprunt se sont egalement deteriorees : le taux des credits immobiliers a trente ans est passe de 5,98 % a 6,65 %. Les performances de l'economie americaine restent par ailleurs eloignees des ambitions affichees par l'administration. Apres une croissance de 2,1 % l'annee derniere, le PIB n'a progresse que de 1,5 % en rythme annuel au deuxieme trimestre 2026. Ces chiffres sont nettement inferieurs aux 5 a 6 % evoques par le secretaire au Commerce, Howard Lutnick, mais aussi a l'objectif de 3 % defendu par le secretaire au Tresor, Scott Bessent. Cette degradation commence egalement a peser sur l'opinion publique. Toujours selon le Financial Times , la confiance des consommateurs americains est tombee a des niveaux historiquement bas depuis le debut de la guerre contre l'Iran. Un nombre croissant d'electeurs considere desormais que la situation economique s'est deterioree sous la presidence de Donald Trump. La guerre a debute en fevrier. Peu apres le declenchement des hostilites, Teheran a annonce le blocus du detroit d'Ormuz, qui est toujours en vigueur. Avant le conflit, cette voie maritime strategique voyait transiter environ un cinquieme du petrole et du gaz naturel liquefie consommes dans le monde.

items.title: The Mid-Block Trap: Why Michael Carrick can’t deliver Manchester United’s modern dynasty
items.description: I am officially taking a tactical sabbatical. For the upcoming season, I am stepping away from the emotional theatre of Old Trafford to quietly study a world-class manager our board should never have dismissed. This is not a petulant strike; it is an act of exhaustion by a fan who views football through a coaching lens. Just as United blundered by parting ways with José Mourinho before his structural foundations could mature, we have repeated history with Rúben Amorim. I will return for the 2027/28 season, but only if the club stops using nostalgia as a strategy and instead embraces a cold, calculated machine capable of winning. The decision by INEOS to sack Amorim and hand the reins to Michael Carrick felt less like a strategic pivot and more like an institutional retreat into a psychological comfort zone. While Carrick’s interim spell has generated plenty of optimistic headlines, an objective, apple-to-apple statistical breakdown of the 2025/26 season reveals that we have traded an elite, progressive identity for a very safe, low-ceiling mirage known as the mid-block trap. Let’s do the Math not the Myth: To understand why our timeline has stalled, we must strip away the emotion and look at the underlying data of the 2025/26 Premier League season. Comparing Amorim’s final 20 games against Carrick’s 18-game tenure exposes a clear tactical regression. Tactical & Statistical Metric Rúben Amorim (3-4-2-1) Michael Carrick (4-4-2 / 4-2-4) Field Tilt (Share of Final-Third Passes) 56.8% 48.2% PPDA (Passes Per Defensive Action) 8.4 (Aggressive Press) 12.1 (Passive Mid-Block) Average Possession % 53.6% 47.4% Expected Goals Against (xGA) per 90 1.32 1.58 Progressive Passes per 90 42.1 31.8 Direct Attacks / Counter-Attacks 1.8 per 90 3.6 per 90 Amorim’s system aimed for structural dominance—suffocating opponents through a high press. His 8.4 PPDA reflects a desire to win the ball back immediately. When injuries struck and key international departures hollowed out the squad, the system stalled due to a severe lack of specialised profiles. The INEOS board failed him completely here, refusing to secure the elite wing-backs and progressive centre-backs his 3-4-2-1 fundamentally required. Carrick , conversely, retreated to a classic, rigid 4-4-2 out of possession that flattened into a basic 4-2-4 when attacking. Looking at the numbers, Carrick’s United willingly surrendered the ball (dropping to 47.4% possession) and stopped pressing (a passive 12.1 PPDA). With Marcus Rashford completely out of the tactical equation—having been exiled by Amorim to spend the season on loan at Barcelona—Carrick engineered a standard mid-block counter-attacking unit. It lowered the physical demands on the squad and secured safe points, but safety does not break down 90-point Premier League low-blocks. The Arsenal Mirror To understand why sacking Amorim was an institutional failure, one need only look at the patience Arsenal afforded Mikel Arteta. Early on, Arteta’s metrics were heavily criticised: slow, automated build-up, and an agonisingly rigid positional structure that frustrated a fan base accustomed to chaotic transitions. But Arteta ruthlessly purged high-earning individualists who compromised his metrics and demanded hyper-specific profiles to complete his machine. Amorim’s data proved he was on a similar trajectory. His 56.8% Field Tilt and 42.1 progressive passes indicated a team successfully learning how to control territory—the foundational metric of all modern title winners. By tearing up his blueprint after just 20 games, INEOS disrupted a compounding process. Carrick’s numbers represent the inverse of sustainable success; trading a 56.8% field tilt for 48.2% means United is no longer commanding matches, they are merely surviving them. The Mainoo Paradox: The Safe Confines of the Trap The emotional catalyst for Amorim’s departure was his handling of Kobbie Mainoo. Pundits and supporters criticised him for limiting the minutes of England’s golden boy because Mainoo lacked the physical profile and positional discipline required for a gruelling two-man pivot in a high-line system. Let us apply a basic coaching assessment: Would a 2025/26 Kobbie Mainoo start for any of the genuine top-four teams in England? At Manchester City , Rodri’s positional perfection and physical dominance are mandatory. Mainoo would sit. At Arsenal , Arteta demands relentless defensive tracking and aerial presence from Declan Rice and Mikel Merino. Mainoo would sit. At Liverpool or Chelsea , the central midfield floor requires elite defensive coverage and hyper-aggressive transitional intensity. Mainoo would be a luxury bench option. Carrick started Mainoo in 16 out of 17 games because his low-block 4-4-2 artificially shielded him, reducing the open turf Mainoo had to cover. The ultimate validation of Amorim’s assessment came at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, where England manager Thomas Tuchel completely froze Mainoo out, handing him zero minutes. Tuchel, a manager obsessed with strict tactical spacing, publicly noted that Mainoo lacked the positional maturity for the highest level. Tuchel treated him exactly the way elite Spanish managers like Vicente del Bosque treated raw, hyper-talented midfielders who hadn’t yet mastered structural discipline: if you cannot hold the tactical shape under maximum pressure, you do not play. When Thomas Tuchel and Rúben Amorim look at a player and conclude he isn’t ready to anchor an elite midfield, we have to ask ourselves: Wasn’t Amorim right all along? Can we split the bill across the pitch As we look at the broader squad balance, Carrick’s safe approach is highly vulnerable to a structural collapse across the entire pitch. The board points to our depth, but a tactical assessment reveals a collection of mismatched profiles rather than a balanced squad. In midfield, Tielemans provides elite vision but zero recovery pace; Andrey Santos offers box-to-box goal-scoring energy but leaves vast structural spaces untracked; Carlos Baleba brings raw athleticism but lacks tactical maturity in structural positioning. Without an elite, prime-age defensive anchor to screen this group, the structural floor is incredibly brittle. This mismatch carries over to the rest of the lines. The defence features profiles built for low-block survival who completely panic when compressed high up the pitch, while the forwards are high-margin transition wingers who completely choke in tight spaces when the build-up fails to evolve smoothly from the back. Compounding this is our insistence on fighting on four fronts simultaneously, chasing the Europa League and domestic cups to appease a silverware-starved fanbase. Because Carrick’s mid-block requires intense, individual recovery runs rather than mechanical rest defence, winter fixture congestion will inevitably force heavy rotation, leading to a drop-off that will cost United the critical 6 to 9 points that decide a title race. Living in h igh- r isk c haos If the internal board strategy is to target a genuine title charge by 2028 , INEOS must face the squad balance dilemma head-on. Furthermore, we must address the ultimate paradox: Bruno Fernandes . By 2028, Bruno will be 33 years old. His entire career is defined by high-risk, high-reward transitional chaos. He thrives when tactical structures break down. Yet, modern league titles are won through mechanical game control, high field tilt, and suffocating possession sustainment. Keeping Bruno as the focal point forces United to remain an emotional, counter-attacking team. To transition into a side that can win 90+ points, Bruno cannot be the centre of the universe. He belongs to United’s decade of transitional firefighting, not a cold, calculated 2028 title run. Project 150 has no room for sentimental caretakers Manchester United is fast approaching its Project 150 milestone—the 150th anniversary of our founding as Newton Heath in 1878. If the goal is to lift the Premier League trophy to celebrate Project 150 in 2028, United MUST be radical . If we remain comfortable, we will miss the project window entirely. INEOS’s biggest mistake was a lack of institutional patience with Amorim, bowing to a media-driven narrative instead of backing a modern system. To rectify this for 2028, the club must let Carrick finish his cycle as a cultural stabiliser, then ruthlessly pivot to a system-driven elite tactician. The profile we must target is not a mid-table overachiever but an elite, uncompromising positional mastermind on the European circuit—a coach in the mould of Luis Enrique or Vicente Del Bosque, or a modern, systematic orchestrator who refuses to compromise on structural dominance. We need a manager who looks at a midfield of Mainoo (then 23) and Santos (then 24), pairs them with a newly signed, world-class defensive anchor, coordinates a synchronised high-line defence, and demands absolute control of the pitch. I have no personal qualms with Michael Carrick. I deeply loved him as a player, and he possesses an admirable footballing mind. But as a coach looking at the cold, hard metrics required to win a modern domestic crown, he is simply not our guy for Project 150. Until the club stops substituting tactical progression for a safe mid-block trap, I will be watching from afar, supporting a manager who understood what modern football actually requires. See you in 2027/28. ***** The Author is a lifelong, deeply invested supporter of Manchester United who analyses football through a rigorous structural lens. He holds an active UEFA C Coaching License.

items.title: NSMQ 2026: St. John’s Grammar crushes St. Mary’s Sem., Zion College to book one-eighth spot
items.description: It was a one-sided affair at the SMS Auditorium as St. John’s Grammar School delivered a dominant performance to dismantle St. Mary’s Seminary SHS and Zion College in Contest 26 of the 2026 National Science and Maths Quiz (NSMQ) preliminaries. St. John’s Grammar immediately seized control in Round One, opening an eight-point lead over Zion College and an 18-point advantage over St. Mary’s Seminary. The gap widened dramatically in Round Two as St. John’s Grammar continued to pile on the points while St. Mary’s Seminary struggled to respond. The Problem of the Day provided another opportunity for St. John’s Grammar to flex its dominance. The school scored an impressive 9 out of 10, while Zion College managed 5 out of 10. St. Mary’s Seminary could not register a correct answer from its two attempts. By the end of Round Three, St. John’s Grammar had stretched its lead to 30 points. Zion College showed signs of a fightback in Round Four, adding 16 points to reduce the deficit, but St. John’s Grammar remained firmly in control. There was little doubt about the winner heading into the finale, and St. John’s Grammar duly completed the job. The school finished with a commanding 60 points, 24 points clear of Zion College, while St. Mary’s Seminary ended the contest on 15 points. It was a difficult contest for the two schools, particularly St. Mary’s Seminary, as St. John’s Grammar turned the SMS Auditorium into a showcase of dominance and secured a convincing victory. items.title: Ganzourgou/Mogtédo : le ROPI reçoit une moto pour renforcer sa mobilité auprès des jeunes
items.description: Burkina/Ganzourgou-ROPI-Don-Moto Ganzourgou/Mogtédo : le ROPI reçoit une moto pour renforcer sa mobilité auprès des jeunes Mogtédo, 19 août 2026 (AIB) – Le Référent opportunités insertion (ROPI) de la commune de Mogtédo a présenté, le mercredi 19 août 2026, une nouvelle moto à la délégation spéciale communale. Ce moyen roulant vise à renforcer la mobilité du ROPI et sa proximité avec les jeunes de la commune. La moto a été dotée par le ministère des Sports, de la jeunesse et de l’emploi dans le cadre du projet « Jeunes en Action », une initiative destinée à favoriser l’autonomisation socioprofessionnelle des jeunes. Le projet est financé par l’Agence italienne pour la coopération au développement (AICS) et la coopération allemande. Il est mis en œuvre par l’UNICEF en collaboration avec le gouvernement burkinabè. Cette dotation doit permettre au ROPI de renforcer ses déplacements dans les différents villages de Mogtédo et d’aller directement à la rencontre des jeunes. Pour le référent Opportunités insertion en service à la mairie de Mogtédo, Jean-Baptiste Ouédraogo, cette moto constitue un appui aux actions d’information, d’orientation et d’insertion professionnelle des jeunes. « Nous sommes fiers de ce geste de nos partenaires, notamment YouthKonect Burkina et ses partenaires, et de ce moyen roulant mis à notre disposition », a-t-il déclaré. Selon lui, le moyen roulant permettra de sillonner les villages de la commune afin d’informer et d’orienter les jeunes vers les opportunités disponibles en matière de formation, d’emploi et d’entrepreneuriat. « Nous allons nous rapprocher des jeunes afin de les orienter vers des opportunités et leur permettre d’avoir un lendemain meilleur », a-t-il ajouté. La délégation spéciale communale de Mogtédo s’est réjouie de cette dotation et a exprimé sa reconnaissance au ministère des Sports, de la Jeunesse et de l’Emploi ainsi qu’aux partenaires ayant contribué à sa mise à disposition. Pour les autorités communales, cette moto répond à un besoin de mobilité du ROPI et devrait faciliter la présence du service auprès des populations. À travers cette dotation, le ROPI de Mogtédo dispose d’un moyen supplémentaire pour améliorer l’accès des jeunes à l’information et aux opportunités d’insertion. Agence d’information du Burkina DMO-MS-DNK

items.title: GRIDCo announces power interruptions in parts of Greater Accra for tower repairs
items.description: The Ghana Grid Company Limited (GRIDCo) has announced planned power interruptions in parts of the Greater Accra Region on Sunday, August 23, to facilitate emergency works on a damaged transmission tower at Ashaiman. According to a statement issued on Saturday, August 22, the affected tower is located on the 161kV Tema–Achimota transmission line and was damaged following a tanker explosion nearby. GRIDCo said its engineers and technical teams will undertake the next phase of the replacement works from 3:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on Sunday to restore the integrity of the transmission line. The company explained that electricity supply to some areas will be interrupted during the exercise to ensure the safety of personnel and the public and allow the technical teams to complete the repairs. GRIDCo said it is working with the Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) to minimise the impact of the outage on affected customers and communities. The company apologised for the inconvenience and appealed to the public for patience and cooperation as the emergency works are completed. “We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience this interruption will cause and request the patience, understanding and cooperation of the public,” GRIDCo said.

items.title: Maroc : des voyageurs algériens et tunisiens refoulés de l’aéroport de Casablanca
items.description: Pour entrer au Maroc, les voyageurs algériens et tunisiens doivent désormais présenter une réservation d’hôtel et un billet d’avion de retour. Les autorités marocaines ont durci les conditions d’entrée sur leur territoire pour les ressortissants de ces pays. Selon le quotidien espagnol La Razón , les autorités marocaines ont commencé à refuser l’entrée sur le territoire à un grand nombre d’Algériens et de Tunisiens, et à les renvoyer immédiatement vers leur pays de provenance. Renforcement des contrôles sur les vols en provenance de Tunisie et de Turquie Le durcissement des règles d’entrée pour ces voyageurs est appliqué notamment à l’aéroport Mohammed V de Casablanca. Objectif affiché : « empêcher l'arrivée de ressortissants qui se rendent ensuite à la frontière avec Ceuta ». Une source marocaine qui voyageait sur un vol reliant Tunis à Casablanca, citée par le même journal, a déclaré que les autorités marocaines ont déployé une équipe de sécurité à la porte d’embarquement des avions en provenance de Tunisie et de Turquie. Ce renforcement du dispositif de contrôle vise à procéder à l’identification des passagers et à renvoyer immédiatement ceux qui ne présentent pas une réservation d’hôtel valide et un billet d’avion de retour. En raison de la suspension des vols entre l’Algérie et le Maroc, les voyageurs algériens souhaitant se rendre au royaume font généralement escale en Tunisie, d’où le renforcement des contrôles sur les voyageurs en provenance de ce pays. Au niveau de la plateforme aéroportuaire de Casablanca, seuls les voyageurs ayant la double nationalité et ceux disposant d’une réservation d’hôtel et d’un billet d’avion de retour sont autorisés à entrer dans le pays. Des voyageurs qui « auraient l’intention de se rendre au Maroc pour s’infiltrer à Ceuta » Selon le journal espagnol, les autorités marocaines agissent ainsi pour empêcher l’accès aux voyageurs qui « auraient l’intention de se rendre au Maroc pour ensuite se diriger vers le nord du royaume et, de là, s’infiltrer à Ceuta ». Selon un témoignage rapporté mercredi 19 août par le journaliste algérien Moncef Ait-Kaci, de nombreux voyageurs algériens ont été refoulés mardi dès leur arrivée à l’aéroport de Casablanca, « sans qu’un motif précis ne leur soit communiqué ». Les autorités marocaines auraient « vaguement évoqué la situation à Ceuta » pour expliquer ces refoulements, selon les termes employés par le témoin. Elles cherchent ainsi à faire diversion en tentant de faire croire que ceux qui tentent de fuir le Maroc vers Ceuta ne sont pas tous Marocains. Fin juillet, près de 72 000 Marocains ont franchi illégalement la frontière pour se rendre dans l’enclave espagnole, provoquant une grave crise migratoire et des tensions en Europe. L’article Maroc : des voyageurs algériens et tunisiens refoulés de l’aéroport de Casablanca est apparu en premier sur TSA .

The governor said he reviewed the pre-election climate of fear and conflict, noting that his team never subscribed to violence as a weapon of political campaign even when under severe pressure in the countdown to the elections. “I am forever a man of peace. It is heartwarming that my brother, Oyebamiji, is also preaching peace. I assure him that my supporters have not and will not attack APC members. “Elections have come and gone and we are all winners. The common task for us all is to sustain delivery of democratic dividends and good governance to the good people of Osun State. “I welcome Mr Gboyega Oyetola, Bola Oyebamiji and other opposition leaders to join hands with me to take Osun to greater heights. We are all important stakeholders in this Osun project,” Governor Adeleke stated. The post Osun election: Adeleke embraces Oyebamiji’s peace call appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: PM Shehbaz takes notice of non-functional CTA machine at PIMS cardiology dept; Imran's related test not performed
items.description: ISLAMABAD: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday took notice of the non-functional computed tomography angiography (CTA) machine at the cardiology department of the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (Pims), after former premier Imran Khan was brought to the hospital for a medical check-up. The premier has constituted a committee, headed by the Establishment Division secretary, to examine all aspects of the matter, determine the facts and fix responsibility. According to a senior doctor who is part of the medical facility’s administration, the lapse occurred after the PTI founder was brought to the hospital in the early hours of Friday without prior intimation, referral or patient registration. “Ideally, Imran Khan should have been brought in daylight, as it was not an emergency case, and he should have been registered as a patient. All departments were not in the loop,” he told Dawn . According to credible sources at Pims, who requested anonymity, Imran’s CTA — commonly known as CT angiography — was recommended, but the test could not be completed because the facility was unavailable. Imran was subsequently taken back to Adiala jail. On Friday, after it emerged that Imran’s CTA could not be conducted at Pims, some senior doctors said the required machine was available in the radiology department, but the information was not brought to the attention of those treating Imran while he was at the hospital. The CTA machine at the Cardiac Centre had been available in 2011 but later became non-functional, the doctors said. A senior doctor added that the Cardiac Centre had a facility for conventional angiography, in which a vein is punctured and a camera is used to diagnose a blockage. The functional CTA machine, however, was available only in the radiology department, the doctor added. Another doctor reiterated that the CTA machine in the radiology department had been functional since March 2022. “The CTA is performed by a radiologist on the advice of clinicians as it uses radiation rather than requiring a vein to be punctured. However, no one advised that Imran be referred to the radiology department,” he said. He further told Dawn that after the matter came to light, Health Secretary Muhammad Aslam Ghauri visited Pims and verified that the machine was available. A senior Pims administrator, who requested anonymity, said cardiologists were asked about the test but told officials that the facility was unavailable. As a result, it was conveyed that Imran Khan’s CTA could not be conducted. “The fact is that most CTAs are referred to private facilities because the machine at the Cardiac Centre is out of order. When the issue was raised on Saturday, the radiology department was asked to provide records of CTAs conducted there. It provided just one report, while claiming that around a dozen others were also available,” he said. The officer, who has administrative responsibilities, said he had been receiving requests from the Cardiac Centre for years to arrange a machine, so no one considered referring Imran to the radiology department. “Moreover, cardiologists used to conduct CTAs themselves in the past, so they are not accustomed to referring patients to the radiology department,” he explained. Inquiry committee According to an official government statement, the premier took notice of the non-functional CTA facility at Pims and constituted an inquiry committee to determine the facts. The premier directed the committee to examine all aspects of the matter and submit a report. The committee would be headed by the Establishment Division secretary, while its members would include National Health Services secretary, Brigadier Dr Jahanzeb Ali of the Armed Forces Institute of Cardiology (AFIC), Dr Nusratullah Chaudhry, Professor Dr Nadeem Hayat Malik, Brigadier (retd) Dr Azmat Hayat of Pims, and AFIC CT angiography technician Umar Farooq. The committee may co-opt any other member if required. According to the terms of reference, the committee will determine whether Pims had the technical capability to perform CTA since 2022 and, if so, whether the required technical facilities, human resources and software were available. It will also examine the number, dates and nature of CTA procedures performed at Pims since 2022, along with relevant hospital records and other documentary evidence. The committee will investigate the coordination and referral mechanisms between the cardiology and radiology departments and assess the role of the hospital administration in providing the facility. It will also examine whether patients in the cardiology department were routinely referred to private medical centres for CTA. In cases of such referrals, the committee will determine whether any particular private facility was given preference and how much business was diverted from the public hospital to private centres. The inquiry committee will further investigate any lack of coordination, mismanagement or misunderstanding between the cardiology and radiology departments that may have resulted in a loss to the public interest and identify the officers or offices responsible. PM Shehbaz directed the committee to conduct a comprehensive examination of all relevant facts and records and submit its report so that further action could be taken in accordance with the law. The National Health Services ministry will provide the necessary assistance to the committee during the inquiry. Imran’s hospital transfer saga On Tuesday, the SC had ordered the government to shift Imran to Shifa International Hospital within two days for examination and treatment by a multidisciplinary medical board. A three-member bench headed by Justice Shahid Waheed and comprising Justices Naeem Akhtar Afghan and Ishtiaq Ibr­ahim issued the interim directions on petitions seeking Imran’s hospitalisation, access to personal physicians and family members and provision of his medical record to his family. The court had also ordered that Dr Uzma Khan and Dr Faisal Sultan — Imran Khan’s personal physician — be present during the medical check-up by a medical board. At the same time, Imran’s family members, PTI members and lawyers associated with him were barred from disclosing his health condition or medical reports to the media or public until the next hearing. The next day, the government had filed a review plea against the court’s order to shift Imran to the private hospital, arguing that the directive was discriminatory and issued in violation of prison rules and principles of natural justice. However, the SC had returned the plea on Thursday with the objection that the contents of the affidavit and facts, along with the review petition filed under Article 188 of the Constitution, had not been properly drawn up and that one of the paper books of was not in order. The same night, elaborate arrangements were put in place in and around Shifa International Hospital, and all signs pointed to the PTI founder being brought there, in compliance with SC order. However, it became clear on Friday morning that Imran had been taken to Pims for a check-up and then subsequently transported back to prison. Information Minister Attaullah Tarar blamed “the security situation created by PTI workers on the way to and outside Al Shifa Hospital” for the diversion. In a post on X, he said, “In the light of the SC’s order, the prisoner was taken to the hospital under appropriate security arrangements during the night between August 20 and 21. “A team of qualified doctors, including an ophthalmologist, a cardiologist, and a physician, conducted a detailed examination of him and declared him medically fit,” he said. Later, the Pims administration said that two specialists from Shifa Inter­national Hospital participated in Imran’s eye assessment, while other exa­minations were carri­­ed out by the concerned Pims specialists. Imran has been taken to Pims multiple times after his eye ailment — right central retinal vein occlusion (CRVO) — came to light in late January. “The clinical input ari­sing from the ophthalmological assessment was taken into account alongside findings of the investigations conducted at Pims,” the statement said. Meanwhile, the government on Thursday filed a fresh review petition against the SC’s Aug 18 order. The Islamabad chief commissioner again filed the plea, saying that his office had a direct, substantial and legally protected interest in the matter and that the Aug 18 order adversely affected its constitutional authority.

items.title: NSMQ 2026: West Africa SHS powers past Oda SHS, Mankessim SHTS to book one-eighth spot on 80th anniversary
items.description: West Africa Senior High School has sent a loud warning to the competition, powering past Oda SHS and Mankessim SHTS to book a place in the One-Eighth Stage of the 2026 National Science and Maths Quiz (NSMQ). With the school celebrating its 80th anniversary, the West Africa SHS team has one bold wish — let history repeat itself! The school emerged victorious after a fiercely contested battle at the NSMQ 2026 Preliminary Stage, finishing on 55 points, with Oda SHS trailing on 41 points and Mankessim SHTS on 37 points. From the opening round, West Africa SHS wasted little time announcing its intentions. While all three schools fought for every available point, West Africa SHS proved particularly sharp on the bonus questions, using them to build an early advantage and put pressure on its rivals. Then came the Speed Race, and Mankessim SHTS came charging. The school repeatedly hit the bell, desperately trying to wrestle control of the round. But West Africa SHS refused to surrender its grip, answering crucial questions and keeping its lead intact. The Problem of the Day offered Mankessim SHTS a brief opportunity to claw back some ground, with the school scoring seven points, while West Africa SHS and Oda SHS managed six points each. But West Africa SHS was already in command. By the end of Round Three, the leaders had stretched their tally to 42 points, leaving Mankessim SHTS on 27 points and Oda SHS on 22. The pressure intensified in the True or False round, but West Africa SHS remained composed, pushing its score to 55 points. Oda SHS fought back to 35 points, while Mankessim SHTS moved to 31 points. The final Riddle round brought the contest to a tense finish, but there was no stopping West Africa SHS. The school held its nerve, crossed the finish line first and secured its much-coveted One-Eighth Stage ticket. But for West Africa SHS, this victory carries an even bigger meaning. As the school celebrates 80 years, its NSMQ journey is being driven by a nostalgic ambition — to repeat the history of 2018. The team is now dreaming of another memorable run in the competition, hoping this anniversary year can once again produce an NSMQ chapter worth celebrating. For Oda SHS and Mankessim SHTS, the journey ends at the preliminaries. For West Africa SHS, however, the real battle has only just begun. items.title: Govt blames PTI for 'violating' SC order, says family committed contempt by issuing statements
items.description: The government on Saturday blamed the PTI for “violating” a Supreme Court (SC) order by issuing statements and speaking to the media following former prime minister Imran Khan’s medical check-up at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (Pims) on Friday. “PML-N believes that health issues should not be used for political gain,” Information Minister Attaullah Tarar told the media. He added that, whether in opposition or in government, the PML-N’s stance had always remained the same: politics and health issues should not be linked. The minister also accused Imran of issuing statements and releasing videos about the health of PML-N leaders when they were incarcerated and he was prime minister. Tarar added that since the SC order regarding Imran’s health was issued, “our government has not mocked him or made any controversial statements”. Recounting events of the past few days, Tarar said that after the SC order was issued, Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar had explained the government’s position on it in detail. “The viewpoint was that whatever will happen, it will be according to the law,” Tarar said. He added that the government’s review petition “respectfully questioned whether the facility was available to every prisoner”. Secondly, he said, the petition questioned whether the law and Constitution allowed Imran to be examined at a private hospital. Tarar then elaborated on the implementation of the SC’s order. “The next question is whether the order was implemented. The answer is yes. Was the check-up conducted? Yes. Was it done transparently? Yes. Was his sister present? Yes. Were doctors from Shifa [Hospital] present? Yes. All the obligations were fulfilled.” Tarar also addressed the communication of these developments to the media and the general public. He said that shortly after the government filed its review petition, the law minister had explained its grounds in detail. He added that after Imran’s check-up was completed at Pims, he himself posted an update on X. Tarar said he was “surprised” by the PTI’s subsequent statements and actions. “PTI is miles away from the light of knowledge,” he said, adding that the party would not have filed a contempt petition had it been aware of the situation. “A baseless contempt petition has been filed .” The facts were shared with the public immediately, he said, adding that the government had maintained transparency throughout. “Contempt has definitely happened,” he said, adding that the SC had directed that no political motives should be involved in the medical check-up. However, Tarar said, people gathered outside Shifa Hospital, created social media content and removed barriers. “Wasn’t it the PTI that did this? Didn’t they violate the court order?” He added that the PTI had also issued statements and spoken at press conferences. “If somebody is in contempt, it is Imran Khan’s sister and his party. “The prisoner’s family was in contempt. His party was in contempt by gathering people and creating problems for the authorities.” He remarked that this was the first time a political party had created problems for its own founder’s health and treatment. Tarar added that earlier the Pakistan Bar Council and Punjab Bar Council had issued statements saying that some lawyers associated with the two bodies were, in their personal capacities, issuing statements to politicise the matter. Both councils had clarified that the bar councils should be kept separate from the issue, he said. “Some lawyers have tried to pollute bar politics,” Tarar said. Eight members of the Pakistan Bar Council (PBC) on Saturday strongly condemned the government’s “blatant, wilful and deliberate violation” of the SC’s Aug 18 order. “The order of the SC was clear, unequivocal and binding yet the executive has chosen to disregard it and has acted in direct defiance of the court’s directions and violated the same,” said a statement issued by the members. Meanwhile, Vice Chairman of the PBC Pir Muhammad Masood Chistie clarified that the statement represented the views of those individual members and could not be treated as the collective position of the PBC. “You obstructed his path. You created a security situation there,” the minister said, addressing PTI leadership. He added that the medical report from Pims had stated that Imran was in good health, prompting the question: “Which illness are you doing politics on?” Imran’s medical treatment had never been stopped or paused and would continue as needed, the information asserted, urging PTI leaders and Imran’s family not to politicise legal or health matters, adding that they had “been in contempt” by commenting on the issue. Tarar issued the statement hours after Dr Uzma Khan, Imran’s sister, approached the SC seeking to initiate contempt proceedings against those responsible for violating its Aug 18 order to shift the incarcerated former premier to a private hospital in the federal capital. On Tuesday, the SC had ordered the government to shift Imran to Shifa International Hospital within two days for examination and treatment by a multidisciplinary medical board. The court had also ordered that Dr Uzma Khan and Dr Faisal Sultan — Imran’s personal physician — be present during the medical examination by the board. At the same time, Imran’s family members, PTI members and lawyers associated with him were barred from disclosing his health condition or medical reports to the media or the public until the next hearing. The next day, the government had filed a review plea against the court’s order to shift Imran to the private hospital, arguing that the directive was discriminatory and issued in violation of prison rules and principles of natural justice. However, the SC had returned the plea on Thursday with the objection that the contents of the affidavit and facts, along with the review petition filed under Article 188 of the Constitution, had not been properly drawn up and that one of the paper books of was not in order. The same night, elaborate arrangements were put in place in and around Shifa International Hospital, and all signs pointed to the PTI founder being brought there, in compliance with SC order. However, it became clear on Friday morning that Imran had been taken to Pims for a check-up and then subsequently transported back to prison. Meanwhile, the government on Thursday filed a fresh review petition against the SC’s Aug 18 order. The Islamabad chief commissioner again filed the plea, saying that his office had a direct, substantial and legally protected interest in the matter and that the Aug 18 order adversely affected its constitutional authority.

items.title: 2027: Tinubu Campaign Council mission dead on arrival — APM
items.description: By Luminous Jannamike The Allied Peoples’ Movement (APM) has declared that President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s newly constituted campaign council is destined to fail, describing the team as an assembly of ‘yes men’ and politically discredited figures ahead of the 2027 presidential election. For the party, the issue goes beyond the personalities on the list. It said the composition of the council reflects what it considers Tinubu’s declining political standing and inability to attract credible figures with the public goodwill, loyalty and confidence needed to prosecute a winning presidential campaign. APM National Publicity Secretary, Abubakar Yusuf, stated this in a statement on Saturday, in which the party particularly attacked the appointment of former Zamfara State Governor, Abdul-Aziz Yari, as Director-General of the campaign. It alleged that insecurity and poor living conditions worsened in Zamfara under Yari’s administration. “If after three and half years in power, President Tinubu could not garner the capacity to assemble a credible team, then it is clear that indeed he has no business being in charge of a nation as complex and demanding as Nigeria,” Yusuf said. The party also accused the campaign council of being populated by “known political sycophants, inconsistent characters and ideology turncoats”, including former governors it claimed had recently faced public rejection in Osun State and politicians seeking political cover amid corruption allegations. APM linked its opposition to Tinubu’s re-election to the administration’s handling of insecurity, claiming that 628,000 Nigerians had been killed and more than 2.2 million others, including children, abducted in the three and a half years since the President assumed office. It also attacked the administration’s economic policies, alleging that more than 140 million Nigerians had been pushed below the poverty line, with unemployment at 33 per cent and national infrastructure in a state of collapse. “How can any well-meaning Nigerian campaign for an administration that has ruined our economy with ill-advised and ill-implemented anti-people policies resulting in the crippling of our national productive sectors?” the party asked. APM said the recent Osun governorship election should serve as a warning to the Tinubu campaign, arguing that the political reception there exposed the limits of the President’s ability to mobilise popular support ahead of 2027. “The APM therefore counsels the Tinubu Campaign Council to note that their mission is dead on arrival,” the party declared. Having taken aim at Tinubu’s record, APM turned to its own alternative, presenting its presidential candidate, Seyi Makinde, as the politician capable of mounting a stronger challenge to the President. The party claimed Makinde was gaining the support of Nigerians as a credible alternative and said his proposed administration would pursue a more transparent and people-centred approach to governance. “Our candidate is armed with a blueprint for a new and transparent approach to governance that puts Nigerians first, prioritizing inclusive human development and wellbeing through people-oriented policies and prudent management of resources,” Yusuf said. According to the party, the blueprint would focus on security of lives and property, industrialisation, massive youth employment, national infrastructure, an efficient public service and sustainable prosperity. APM urged Nigerians not to be discouraged by the composition of Tinubu’s campaign council, but to look instead towards what it described as a ‘new beginning’ under a proposed Makinde/Daura presidency. The post 2027: Tinubu Campaign Council mission dead on arrival — APM appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: How Relationships Can Change Your Personality
items.description: This is an edition of The Wonder Reader, a newsletter in which our editors recommend a set of stories to spark your curiosity and fill you with delight. Sign up here to get it every Saturday morning. A few years ago, my colleague Faith Hill reported on what psychologists call the “Michelangelo phenomenon”: the idea that over time, romantic partners mold each other. “Some researchers have found that when that happens, the art tends to look conspicuously like the artist,” she wrote. Researchers aren’t in agreement about why exactly people in relationships become more alike as time goes on. Couples might also just imagine that they’re becoming alike, Faith notes; we’d prefer to think that a long-term partner is developing in the same ways that we are, even if that’s not entirely true. Whatever the precise explanation, that fact that partners can begin to resemble each other is a reminder of the power of love to change us—not just to change our lives, but to actually alter who we are at our core. Today’s newsletter rounds up stories about how relationships of all kinds can influence your personality. I recently asked readers to share a photo of something that sparks their sense of awe in the world. “Every day for the last month this beautiful monarch butterfly has been visiting my balcony garden,” Maureen T., 76 , from Toronto, writes. “I sit and watch and wonder at its beauty. I even named him Fred.” I’ll continue to feature your responses in the coming weeks. — Isabel

items.title: Trump heads into midterms short on foreign policy wins
items.description: With the Iran war now at a costly standoff and crises from Ukraine to Gaza still unresolved, President Donald Trump’s ambitious foreign policy agenda appears stuck as he heads into November’s midterm elections. The setbacks are striking for a president who returned to office last ​year promising to be a “peacemaker” and made resolving international conflicts a centerpiece of his second-term agenda. Trump has grown impatient with reporters’ questions and even US allies. This week, he lashed out at reporters ‌pressing him on foreign policy issues and renewed his threat to bomb Oman, a US ally negotiating with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Labor Day, on September 7 this year, is traditionally when election campaigns kick into high gear, and Republicans face the prospect that unresolved conflicts abroad and their economic fallout at home could cost the party its hold on Congress. Iran stalemate takes political toll Trump has called off talks with Tehran after pushing for weeks for a diplomatic solution and announced on Wednesday a new campaign of “economic warfare” against the Iran in an ​apparent acknowledgment that months of military attacks have not forced the concessions the US wants to see. As inflation persists and the Iran war drives up gasoline prices, Trump’s approval rating has fallen to another low point with just ​33 per cent of Americans in the latest Reuters/Ipsos poll approving of his performance. Other efforts to broker peace have also stalled. On Monday, Trump’s negotiator and son-in-law Jared Kushner left empty-handed from talks to ⁠advance a Gaza peace deal. And an expected visit to Kyiv by Kushner and Trump envoy Steve Witkoff to revive long-stalled negotiations to end Russia’s war in Ukraine has yet to happen. After a string of early foreign policy achievements, including ​a Gaza ceasefire and the capture of Venezuela’s leader , Trump’s record has become increasingly defined by his stalled diplomatic efforts. “Trump has successfully challenged and disrupted the comfortable foreign policy consensus in Washington, but has not translated that disruption into a strategy with ​deliverables for Americans,” said Asli Aydintasbas, a fellow at the Brookings Institution think tank in Washington. Iran war tests Trump at home The conflict with Iran has weighed “intensely” on the president and there is no consensus inside the White House on how to resolve it, one Trump ally said on condition of anonymity. The pressure could increase if investors conclude the war will drag on, driving up US borrowing costs and further constraining Trump’s domestic agenda. Trump has said the economic costs are worth it in order to ensure Iran does not obtain a nuclear weapon despite ​Iran’s denials it seeks one. “President Trump has successfully made America respected again, and the results speak for themselves – nine wars have ended, hostages have been freed from Gaza, trade deals are fairer, and now, Iran will be prevented from ever possessing ​a nuclear weapon,“ said White House spokeswoman Anna Kelly. A senior Trump administration official said US sanctions and a naval blockade had crippled Iran’s economy and left it “completely broke,” adding, “There are many levers the president can crank harder in the weeks ahead.” An unorthodox style with mixed results Some experts ⁠give Trump credit for a willingness to grapple with issues they believe other presidents have been unable or unwilling to solve. “The president wants a more stable world and that means attempting to resolve disputes, whether hot like Ukraine or cold like trade and overcapacity,” said Nick Snyder, a senior fellow at Hudson Institute, adding that Trump also worked to settle conflicts between Rwanda and the Democratic Republic of Congo and Thailand and Cambodia. Trump has upended traditional diplomatic norms of peacemaking, relying on leveraging America’s economic and military might including with US allies, but that unorthodox style has yielded mixed results. He brought parties to the table with the aim of ending Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, but the longest war in Europe since World War Two is nowhere ​near ending. In Gaza, mediators fear ⁠that intensifying Israeli strikes on the enclave undermine efforts to end the conflict as both Israel and Hamas balk at conditions needed to advance a peace plan Trump forged in October last year. One notable success came in Venezuela, where the ​US military captured President Nicolas Maduro without US casualties. Analysts say the operation helped convince Trump that joining Israel in attacking Iran would also proceed smoothly. But they also say ​that proved a miscalculation. They argue ⁠Trump has relied too heavily on applying coercive pressure even though Iran’s leaders have little incentive to back down and reopen the Strait of Hormuz despite the country’s weakening economy. “He is obsessed with applying coercion, and sometimes flattery, to bend others to his will, but oblivious to their strategic goals and domestic politics. As a result, he keeps flailing and failing,” said Stephen Wertheim, a senior fellow at Carnegie Endowment for International Peace. Meanwhile, the political clock is ticking, with Trump’s Republican Party facing elections that could cost ⁠it control of ​one or both chambers of Congress and sharply curtail his ability to advance his agenda during his final two years in office. Analysts say Trump’s reliance ​on coercive pressure can bring adversaries to the table but often fails to produce lasting settlements, a dynamic that may encourage rivals to wait him out. “US adversaries understand that his political clock is shorter than theirs, and that while the United States can apply enormous coercive pressure, it may eventually ​lose patience,” Aydintasbas said. “Putin, Xi and Iran may therefore want to wait out Washington. After November, the incentive to wait out Trump will become even more pronounced.”

items.title: ONU : Washington prévoit de verser 725 millions de dollars pour réduire ses arriérés
items.description: L'administration de Donald Trump a informe le Congres de son intention de debloquer 725 millions de dollars afin de regler une partie des sommes dues par les etats-Unis a l'Organisation des Nations unies, selon une notification du departement d'etat americain citee par Reuters le 21 août . Le montant annonce reste toutefois tres eloigne des plus de 4 milliards de dollars que l'ONU considere comme des arrieres americains. Washington conteste cette estimation et affirme que sa dette est nettement moins elevee, notamment parce qu'une partie des sommes aurait deja ete versee. Pour les specialistes du financement de l'aide internationale, ce paiement constitue neanmoins une premiere avancee vers la reduction des arrieres accumules par les etats-Unis. Eugene Chen, ancien responsable de l'ONU, estime que l'arrivee de ces fonds pourrait notamment permettre a l'organisation de repousser de nouvelles mesures d'economie a court terme. Elle serait cependant insuffisante pour resoudre durablement le probleme. La dette americaine envers les Nations unies a depasse les 4 milliards de dollars. Sur cette somme, environ 2,04 milliards correspondent au budget ordinaire de l'organisation et pres de 2,2 milliards au financement des operations de maintien de la paix. Quelque 44 millions de dollars supplementaires sont dus au titre des tribunaux de l'ONU. Les retards de paiement des etats membres ont place l'organisation dans une situation financiere difficile, la contraignant a reduire ses depenses. Ces economies se sont notamment traduites par une diminution des effectifs du secretariat ainsi que par des coupes dans certaines activites et certains programmes. Depuis son retour au pouvoir, l'administration Trump critique regulierement le fonctionnement des Nations unies et plaide pour une reduction de leurs depenses. Le projet de budget americain pour l'exercice 2026 prevoyait notamment de supprimer le financement de plusieurs operations de maintien de la paix. En juillet 2026, les Nations unies tablaient deja sur un versement supplementaire de Washington. Celui-ci aurait dû permettre de ramener les arrieres americains a environ 1,3 a 1,4 milliard de dollars d'ici a la fin de l'annee. Les etats-Unis demeurent le premier contributeur financier de l'ONU. Outre leurs contributions obligatoires au budget ordinaire et aux operations de maintien de la paix, ils financent volontairement certains programmes. Le niveau des contributions obligatoires de chaque etat est fixe selon un bareme prenant notamment en compte sa situation economique.

items.title: Kogi govt orders probe as four family members die after eating Amala
items.description: By Boluwaji Obahopo, Lokoja ‎ ‎Tragedy has struck Ihima community in Okehi Local Government Area of Kogi State, following the reported deaths of four members of the same family after they allegedly consumed a local delicacy identified as Amala (cassava flour). ‎ ‎The deaths have triggered concern in the community, with the circumstances surrounding the incident yet to be established as the state government moves to investigate the reported fatalities. ‎ ‎The incident took a more disturbing turn following reports that the family’s dog also died after consuming the same food, raising concerns over possible food contamination or poisoning. ‎ ‎The Kogi State Government, reacting to the development on Saturday, ordered an immediate investigation into the deaths to determine what may have caused the tragedy. ‎ ‎The Commissioner for Information and Communications, Kingsley Femi Fanwo, said Governor Ahmed Usman Ododo had directed the Commissioner for Health to commence a comprehensive investigation into the incident. ‎ ‎According to Fanwo, the investigation would establish whether the food consumed by the deceased was contaminated or whether another medical or environmental factor was responsible for the deaths. ‎ ‎“The Chief Servant is deeply concerned by this tragic incident and has directed the Commissioner for Health to immediately investigate the circumstances surrounding the deaths, with particular attention to the possibility of food poisoning or food contamination,” Fanwo quoted the governor as saying. ‎ ‎The government also directed that relevant samples and available evidence be properly examined in line with established public health procedures, while the Ministry of Health is expected to work with relevant agencies and stakeholders in conducting the investigation. ‎ ‎Fanwo said the report of the dog’s death after consuming the same food would also form part of the investigation, stressing that the government would base any further public health action on the findings. ‎ ‎Meanwhile, the state government urged residents to remain calm and refrain from drawing conclusions about the cause of the deaths until the investigation is concluded and the facts established by the relevant authorities. ‎ ‎Governor Ododo, according to the commissioner, commiserated with the bereaved family and the people of Ihima over what he described as a painful incident, while assuring residents that the government would make further information available as soon as verified facts emerge. The post Kogi govt orders probe as four family members die after eating Amala appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Patrimoine bâti public : le MATD ordonne le recensement des baux emphytéotiques et autres contrats de bail
items.description: Dans un communiqué publié ce vendredi 21 août 2026, le ministère de l’Administration du territoire et de la Décentralisation (MATD) ordonne le recensement des baux emphytéotiques et autres contrats de bail conclus par les collectivités décentralisées sur l’ensemble du territoire national. Cette opération intervient, selon le département, dans le cadre du renforcement du contrôle de la gestion du patrimoine des collectivités et conformément aux dispositions des articles 264 et suivants de la loi L/2017/040/AN/2017 portant Code révisé des collectivités locales. Les autorités administratives territoriales et les collectivités décentralisées sont invitées à procéder à un recensement exhaustif des contrats concernés. Les maires doivent notamment identifier et transmettre les baux emphytéotiques ainsi que les autres contrats de bail portant sur des biens relevant du domaine public ou du patrimoine des collectivités. Les dossiers devront être accompagnés, lorsqu’ils existent, des avenants et des pièces justificatives y afférentes. Dans l’attente de l’achèvement de cette opération, le ministère suspend toute nouvelle initiative visant la conclusion, le renouvellement ou la prorogation d’un bail emphytéotique ou de tout autre contrat de bail, jusqu’à nouvel ordre. Les résultats du recensement devront être transmis au ministère de l’Administration du territoire et de la Décentralisation dans un délai impératif de 72 heures à compter de la date de signature du communiqué. Les gouverneurs des régions administratives sont chargés d’assurer la coordination et le suivi de l’opération dans leurs circonscriptions respectives. À Conakry, la gouverneure de la région spéciale, ainsi que les préfets et sous-préfets, devront veiller à la stricte application de ces instructions par les collectivités relevant de leur ressort.

items.title: Washington impose des surtaxes de 50 % sur certains produits canadiens après l’échec des pourparlers
items.description: Les États-Unis ont imposé, dès samedi, des droits de douane de 50 % sur plusieurs produits canadiens, après l’échec, vendredi soir, des négociations de dernière minute entre les deux pays. Ces surtaxes concernent des produits d’une valeur de 20 milliards de dollars, poussant le Canada à menacer de mesures de rétorsion, rapportent les médias américains. Les deux parties s’étaient engagées dans d’intenses négociations après que le président Donald Trump eut accordé mercredi un délai de trois jours avant l’entrée en vigueur des nouvelles mesures tarifaires. Malgré des déclarations optimistes de responsables canadiens, dont le Premier ministre Mark Carney, le représentant américain au Commerce, Jamieson Greer, a annoncé vendredi soir l’échec des discussions. Faute d’accord, les nouveaux droits de douane, qui s’appliquent à environ 5 % des exportations canadiennes vers les États-Unis, sont entrés en vigueur samedi à 00h01 (GMT-4). Ils toucheront notamment le vin, les crosses de hockey et le ciment, tout en excluant certains secteurs stratégiques, dont l’énergie, les produits de la pêche et les minéraux critiques. En réaction, M. Carney a qualifié les exigences américaines d’“injustes, anti-économiques et qu’elles remettaient en question la fiabilité de tout accord”. Il a annoncé l’imposition de droits de douane de rétorsion, “dollar pour dollar”, sur les produits américains, ainsi que la mise en place, dans les prochains jours, de mesures de soutien aux travailleurs canadiens. The post Washington impose des surtaxes de 50 % sur certains produits canadiens après l’échec des pourparlers appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Ganzourgou/Mogtédo : la commune veut mieux coordonner les interventions des acteurs de développement
items.description: Burkina/Ganzourgou-CCP Ganzourgou/Mogtédo : la commune veut mieux coordonner les interventions des acteurs de développement Mogtédo, 19 août 2026 (AIB) – La délégation spéciale communale de Mogtédo a tenu, mercredi 19 août 2026, la première session ordinaire du Cadre de concertation communal. Les échanges ont porté sur la pré-validation du rapport provisoire de la cartographie des intervenants et des interventions de développement dans la commune. La rencontre a bénéficié de l’appui de l’Agence belge de développement (Enabel), dans le cadre de son accompagnement aux collectivités territoriales. Le rapport présenté au cours de la session recense les projets et programmes mis en œuvre dans la commune ainsi que les acteurs non étatiques qui y interviennent. Selon le chef du service du suivi des investissements publics à la Direction régionale de l’économie et de la planification, Tasséré Belemsigri, l’étude a permis d’identifier 77 acteurs de développement non étatiques, notamment des associations de développement et des sociétés coopératives. « L’objectif est de permettre à la commune d’avoir une vue d’ensemble sur les acteurs qui l’accompagnent dans son développement, afin de mieux coordonner leurs actions », a-t-il expliqué. Pour le chef de projet Enabel Koupéla, Sondema Kologo, cette cartographie s’inscrit dans l’approche territoriale intégrée mise en œuvre pour accompagner les communautés à travers les délégations spéciales. Il a indiqué que le document renseigne sur les acteurs présents, les secteurs d’intervention et les zones couvertes ou insuffisamment prises en compte. Il devrait ainsi servir de référence à la commune pour orienter les actions de développement et favoriser les échanges entre intervenants. M. Belemsigri a salué la participation des populations et des acteurs non étatiques au processus. Leurs observations et suggestions ont contribué, selon lui, à améliorer le contenu du rapport. Le Président de la délégation spéciale (PDS) de Mogtédo, N. Abdoulaye Kanazoé, s’est réjoui de l’aboutissement de cette étape. Il a estimé que la cartographie devrait contribuer à réduire les chevauchements entre les interventions. « Quand les tiges sont ensemble, elles procurent beaucoup de feu, mais quand elles sont éparpillées, elles procurent moins de feu », a-t-il déclaré, appelant les acteurs à renforcer leur synergie. Le PDS a annoncé une prochaine rencontre avec les ONG et associations intervenant dans la commune afin de planifier et d’harmoniser leurs activités. Les acteurs absents de la session seront également contactés pour être informés de la nouvelle feuille de route. Au titre des divers, le PDS a invité les associations présentes à échanger leurs contacts afin de faciliter leur collaboration. Il a aussi appelé les populations à lutter contre la divagation des animaux et à renforcer la protection des enfants et des femmes enceintes contre le paludisme en cette période de pluie. La session devrait ainsi servir de cadre à une meilleure coordination entre la délégation spéciale, les services techniques, les organisations de la société civile et les autres acteurs intervenant dans le développement de la commune. Agence d’information du Burkina DMO-MS-DNK

items.title: Burkina: un spécialiste propose huit mesures pour protéger les femmes enceintes du paludisme sur les sites d’orpaillage
items.description: Burkina: un spécialiste propose huit mesures pour protéger les femmes enceintes du paludisme sur les sites d'orpaillage Ouagadougou, 21 août 2026 (AIB)-Le Dr Koama Ahmed, spécialiste en santé publique et communautaire, a formulé huit recommandations destinées à protéger les femmes enceintes et les nouveau-nés du paludisme sur les sites d'exploitation minière artisanale du Burkina Faso, a appris l'AIB. Selon le Dr Koama Ahmed, également spécialiste en ophtalmologie et en santé-sécurité-environnement, les femmes enceintes vivant ou travaillant sur ces sites sont particulièrement exposées au paludisme. Les excavations, trous abandonnés et points d'eau stagnante qui caractérisent ces zones constituent en effet des gîtes larvaires favorables à la prolifération des moustiques anophèles, vecteurs de la maladie. Il rappelle que la grossesse fragilise davantage l'organisme face aux formes graves du paludisme, avec des risques d'anémie sévère et d'accès pernicieux pour la mère, ainsi que de faible poids de naissance, de prématurité ou de perte fœtale pour l'enfant. Pour limiter ces risques, le spécialiste préconise huit gestes essentiels : dormir chaque nuit sous une moustiquaire imprégnée d'insecticide ; porter des vêtements couvrants à la tombée de la nuit ; assainir le cadre de vie en éliminant les eaux stagnantes. Il propose aussi d'effectuer régulièrement les consultations prénatales, de suivre le traitement préventif intermittent recommandé par le ministère de la Santé et de proscrire toute automédication. Le spécialiste recommande enfin de consulter sans délai en cas de fièvre, maux de tête, frissons ou fatigue et d'entamer immédiatement le traitement prescrit dès confirmation du diagnostic. Le Dr Koama Ahmed insiste sur la nécessité d'un suivi médical rigoureux dans ces zones où précarité, mobilité et risques sanitaires se conjuguent, estimant que le respect de ces mesures peut faire la différence entre une grossesse à risque et une naissance en bonne santé. Agence d'information du Burkina RK/ata

items.title: Lavrov : «Dans l'Europe d'aujourd’hui, il n'y a personne avec qui négocier»
items.description: « Tous les pays occidentaux, qui nous ont declare la guerre par l'intermediaire des mains et des corps du regime nazi de Kiev, esperaient depuis des annees que nous viendrions negocier avec eux. Nous n'irons pas negocier avec eux. Dans l'Europe d'aujourd'hui, il n'y a personne avec qui negocier », a declare, ce samedi 22 août, le ministre russe des Affaires etrangeres, Sergueï Lavrov, a l'issue de la seance pleniere de la deuxieme phase du XXIIIe congres du parti Russie unie. Sergueï Lavrov a egalement assure que la confrontation avec les pays occidentaux n'empecherait pas la Russie de poursuivre son developpement et de se fixer des objectifs ambitieux. Le gouvernement entend, selon lui, continuer a travailler au developpement socio-economique du pays et a la defense des interets de ses citoyens. Le chef de la diplomatie russe a estime que ces objectifs seraient atteints malgre la guerre declaree contre la Russie. D'apres lui, celle-ci viserait a detruire ou a morceler le pays, ou, selon une formulation desormais privilegiee en Occident, a lui infliger une « defaite strategique ». Le ministre a par ailleurs insiste sur la cohesion de la societe russe. Il a affirme que la societe russe etait aujourd'hui plus unie que jamais. Selon lui, la majorite des citoyens comprennent pourquoi la Russie mene son operation militaire en Ukraine. Lavrov rejette l'idee d'un gel du conflit sur la ligne de contact Le ministre s'est aussi oppose a l'hypothese d'un cessez-le-feu qui laisserait inchangee la situation de part et d'autre de la ligne de contact. Il reagissait notamment a l'idee, avancee par des responsables europeens, de deployer en Ukraine des « forces de stabilisation » en cas de treve. Sergueï Lavrov a estime que l'acceptation d'un tel scenario reviendrait a laisser subsister, de l'autre cote de la ligne de front, un regime nazi. Il a notamment reproche aux autorites ukrainiennes d'avoir interdit par la loi l'usage d'une langue entiere, faisant allusion a la langue russe. Le ministre a ensuite elargi son propos a l'Europe. Selon lui, les « metastases du nazisme » qui y avaient pris racine ces dernieres annees avant de gagner l'Ukraine seraient, dans le cadre d'un tel cessez-le-feu, non seulement preservees, mais aussi renforcees et susceptibles de continuer a se developper. Une telle issue constituerait, a ses yeux, une trahison de l'heritage des generations qui ont vaincu le nazisme. Lavrov a etabli a cet egard un parallele avec les accords de Minsk. Selon lui, si la Russie s'arretait aujourd'hui sur la ligne de contact, le meme scenario se reproduirait : cette periode serait utilisee pour renforcer militairement l'Ukraine, comme cela avait ete le cas apres la signature des accords de Minsk. Des tentatives d'ingerence vouees a l'echec Le ministre russe des Affaires etrangeres a egalement fait etat d'une multiplication des tentatives occidentales visant a perturber les elections a la Douma prevues en septembre. Il a toutefois affirme que leurs chances d'aboutir seraient nulles. Sergueï Lavrov a assure que les forces de l'ordre et les services de securite russes prendraient les mesures necessaires pour empecher de telles actions des leur apparition.

items.title: Deux enfants tués et deux adultes blessés lors d’une attaque de drones ukrainiens dans la région de Krasnodar
items.description: Une attaque de drones ukrainiens a frappe, dans la matinee du 22 août, le district de Ieïsk, dans la region de Krasnodar, au sud de la Russie. Des habitations et des infrastructures civiles ont ete touchees. Selon le gouverneur regional Veniamin Kondratyev, une famille a ete atteinte : deux enfants ont ete tues et deux adultes blesses ont ete hospitalises. Reagissant a l'attaque, le gouverneur a denonce « une nouvelle frappe vile et cynique du regime de Kiev ». Le gouverneur a egalement presente ses condoleances aux proches des victimes, estimant qu'« aucun mot ne pourra les reconforter ». Les deux adultes blesses ont ete pris en charge a l'hopital. Des infrastructures civiles et le port touches L'attaque a egalement eu des consequences sur les infrastructures locales. Des debris de drones ont atteint une entreprise situee dans le port de Ieïsk, ou un incendie s'est declare. Les equipes de secours ont ete mobilisees pour maîtriser le feu. Dans les secteurs residentiels, les services d'urgence sont egalement intervenus sur les lieux ou des drones ou leurs fragments sont retombes. L'entreprise touchee, Ieïsk-Port-Vista, se trouve dans la zone portuaire. Face aux consequences de l'attaque, les autorites municipales ont reuni en urgence la commission chargee de la prevention et de la gestion des situations d'urgence afin de coordonner les mesures necessaires. Plusieurs dispositifs d'assistance ont parallelement ete deployes pour les habitants. Le parquet de la region de Krasnodar supervise le respect des droits des personnes touchees, tandis qu'une ligne telephonique speciale a ete ouverte pour fournir une aide juridique. Les services regionaux ont egalement ete charges d'accompagner les habitants dont les biens ont ete endommages. Une attaque massive contre plusieurs regions russes La frappe contre Ieïsk fait partie d'une attaque de drones de grande ampleur menee dans la nuit du 21 au 22 août contre plusieurs regions de Russie. Selon le ministere russe de la Defense, les systemes de defense aerienne ont intercepte et detruit 457 drones ukrainiens au-dessus de differentes regions du pays, ainsi qu'au-dessus de la mer Noire et de la mer d'Azov. Dans le district de Ieïsk, l'alerte aux drones a ete declenchee des 4h40. Le chef du district, Roman Bublik, a indique que les forces russes avaient abattu la majorite des appareils engages dans l'attaque. Malgre la neutralisation de la plupart des drones, les consequences de l'offensive ont ete particulierement lourdes pour les personnes touchees et les pertes civiles n'ont pas pu etre evitees. Apres la mort des deux enfants, les autorites locales ont decrete une journee de deuil dans l'ensemble du district de Ieïsk. Tous les evenements prevus, notamment a l'occasion de la Journee du drapeau russe, ont ete annules.
